picks.title: Day 347- How to Truly Benefit From the Qur’an | Qaf 27-45, Dhariyat 1-6
picks.summary: What kind of heart is ready to benefit from the Qur’an?In today’s episode, we reflect on the qualities Allah praises at the end of Surah Q: the person who constantly returns to Allah, guards His limits, fears Him in private, and comes to Him with a heart that keeps turning back.We also explore why simply hearing the Qur’an is not the same as being transformed by it. Ibn al-Qayyim explains that guidance requires a living heart, attentive listening, and true presence.And when growth feels slow, these verses remind us that lasting change often develops gradually. picks.reason: Examines how to truly benefit from Quran through heart, presence, and spiritual transformation.

picks.showTitle: Quran in a Year+ (with Imam Saif Morad)
picks.title: Day 346- When Truth Is Rejected, Confusion Follows | Qaf 1-26
picks.summary: Surah Qaf brings us back to some of the most foundational truths of faith.In this episode, we reflect on how truth gives a person stability while rejecting it leads to confusion, why the signs of Allah only transform the heart that keeps returning to Him, and what it means to live knowing that Allah knows even the thoughts we never speak.The surah teaches us to move through life with clarity, reflection, and murāqabah: awareness of Allah in both our public and private lives.A reminder that in a world full of competing voices, the Qur’an gives the believer something firm to stand on.
picks.reason: Reflects on faith, truth, divine awareness, and living with clarity and mindfulness of Allah.

picks.showTitle: Quran Garden - The Holy Quran Explained in Clear English (English Tafsir)
picks.title: Surah An-Nisaa: The Women - Verse 47 - Allah's Curse
picks.summary: In today's tafsir, we respond to critics of the Quran who claim that Muslims cannot agree on the meaning of its verses.  We examine the meanings behind the word "curse" and explore how God's blessings are often hidden behind life's difficulties.
picks.reason: Explores divine curse and blessings with reflection on life's difficulties and Quranic meanings.

picks.title: Clear Intentions In A Chaotic World | Anchored Ep. 1
picks.summary: Should you seek Islamic knowledge? Work for Big Tech? Get involved in politics? Make hijrah? Use AI? These are some of the complicated questions that shape the decisions Muslims have to make every day, as students, professionals, parents, community members, and even in their personal worship. And answering them starts with reflecting on the foundation of everything we do in life: intention (niyyah). After introducing us to the great scholar Imam an-Nawawi (rh), Sh. Mohammad Elshinawy explains what every Muslim must know about intention.
picks.reason: Discusses intention as foundation for ethical and spiritual decisions in a Muslim's life.

picks.title: "You're Cursed" — Eyebrow Plucking, Refusing Your Husband & the Rib Metaphor Explained
picks.summary: In this lecture, we break down some of the most misunderstood hadiths about women, covering eyebrow grooming, the "angels curse her" hadith on marital intimacy, and the famous rib metaphor.
picks.reason: Clarifies misunderstood hadiths about women, addressing ethical and social questions in Islam.
